regexCodeList.string: (?:No Problem!|snickers nervously\.|looks a little worried about the idea\.|should be a fair fight!|chuckles at the thought of you fighting|would crush you like a bug!|would dance on your grave!|would be easy, but is it even worth the work out\?|BEGONE FROM MY SIGHT)

Script.name: consider
Script.script:
--[[ Consider Sean Stoves, 2026-08-01
'con all' rates everything in the room, one line of prose per mob. Past about three mobs that's a paragraph you have to read rather than glance at, and the thing you actually want - can I take it - is buried at the end of the sentence.
So the line gets rewritten where it stands: verdict first, colour-coded, then the level difference, the name, and any flags.
-5 (Golden Aura) No Problem! A guard of the Burh is weak compared to you. weak -5 A guard of the Burh (Golden Aura)
Aardwolf's verdicts, easiest to hardest. The MUD's own strings:
would be easy, but is it even worth the work out? No Problem! ... is weak compared to you. snickers nervously. looks a little worried about the idea. should be a fair fight! chuckles at the thought of you fighting would crush you like a bug! would dance on your grave! says 'BEGONE FROM MY SIGHT unworthy!'
'con all' prefixes the level difference; plain 'consider <mob>' doesn't, so the number is optional. Flags are parenthesised before the verdict and there can be more than one.
Written from that output and Aardwolf's own messages. Not a port of Mushclient-Consider, which is GPL-3.0; see CREDITS.md. ]]
solao = solao or {} solao.con = solao.con or {}
local C = solao.con local U = solao.util
local CFG = U.load("consider", { on = true })
-- label, colour, and the MUD wording that means it. Ranking is ours. local VERDICT = { { "trivial", "#5a7a5a", "would be easy, but is it even worth the work out%?" }, { "weak", "#3ad07a", "No Problem!" }, { "nervous", "#9ece6a", "snickers nervously%." }, { "worried", "#c8d05a", "looks a little worried about the idea%." }, { "fair", "#e0af68", "should be a fair fight!" }, { "hard", "#e08a68", "chuckles at the thought of you fighting" }, { "crushing", "#f7768e", "would crush you like a bug!" }, { "deadly", "#e94560", "would dance on your grave!" }, { "no chance", "#b02a4a", "BEGONE FROM MY SIGHT" }, }
local NAME = { "^No Problem!%s*(.-) is weak compared to you%.$", "^(.-) would be easy", "^(.-) snickers nervously", "^(.-) looks a little worried", "^(.-) should be a fair fight", "^(.-) chuckles at the thought", "^(.-) would crush you", "^(.-) would dance on your grave", "^(.-) says 'BEGONE", }
function C.on_line() if not CFG.on then return end
local line = U.trim(getCurrentLine() or "") if line == "" then return end
local label, colour for _, v in ipairs(VERDICT) do if line:find(v[3]) then label, colour = v[1], v[2]; break end end if not label then return end
-- optional level difference, then any number of (flag) groups local lvl, rest = line:match("^(%-?%d+)%s+(.*)$") rest = rest or line
local flags = {} while true do local f, tail = rest:match("^%((.-)%)%s*(.*)$") if not f then break end flags[#flags + 1] = f rest = tail end
local name for _, pat in ipairs(NAME) do name = rest:match(pat) if name and name ~= "" then break end end if not name or name == "" then return end
deleteLine() U.out(string.format("<%s>%-9s<r> <#8a93a8>%3s<r> <#c8d0dc>%s<r>%s", colour, label, lvl and (tonumber(lvl) > 0 and ("+" .. lvl) or lvl) or "", name, #flags > 0 and (" <#7aa2f7>(" .. table.concat(flags, ") (") .. ")<r>") or "")) end
function C.cmd(arg) local verb = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "" or verb == "status" then U.help("Consider", { { "rewriting", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "" }, { "xcon on | off", "rewrite the lines, or leave the MUD's own" }, { "" }, { "Type 'con all' at the MUD; this tidies the answer in place." }, { "Verdict first and colour-coded, because 'can I take it' is the" }, { "point and the MUD buries it at the end of the sentence." }, })
elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on") U.save("consider", CFG) U.ok("Consider lines " .. (CFG.on and "rewritten." or "left as the MUD sends them."))
else U.warn("xcon [on|off]") end end
solao.register("xcon", "tidies what 'con all' says about the room", C.cmd)
